components.name: Swatch Card

components.html:
Papers & boards

AED 4.80 / sheet
components.css: .ds-swatch{width:240px;background:#fff;border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgb(17 20 27/.06),0 1px 3px rgb(17 20 27/.08);transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s}.ds-swatch:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 18px 32px -14px rgb(17 20 27/.28)}.ds-swatch-tab{height:28px;background:hsl(213 70% 39%);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 12px;font:600 12px Archivo,sans-serif;font-stretch:72%;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-swatch-tab i{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:hsl(60 4% 92%)}.ds-swatch-img{aspect-ratio:4/3;background:hsl(60 4% 92%)}.ds-swatch-body{padding:14px;display:grid;gap:6px;font:400 13px Geist,sans-serif;color:hsl(220 8% 36%)}.ds-swatch-body b{font:600 15.5px Archivo,sans-serif;color:hsl(222 18% 11%)}.ds-spec{justify-self:start;font:11.5px 'Geist Mono',monospace;border:1px solid rgb(23 26 33/.15);border-radius:2px;padding:4px 6px;color:hsl(222 18% 11%)}.ds-swatch-body p{margin:6px 0 0;padding-top:8px;border-top:1px dashed rgb(23 26 33/.15);font:600 18px Archivo,sans-serif;color:hsl(222 18% 11%)}.ds-swatch-body em{font:400 12.5px Geist,sans-serif;color:hsl(220 8% 36%);font-style:normal}

components.name: Mill Label
components.description: Spec table: condensed caps keys, mono values.
components.css: .ds-mill{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;border-top:2px solid hsl(222 18% 11%);margin:0;width:280px}.ds-mill dt,.ds-mill dd{padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgb(23 26 33/.12);margin:0}.ds-mill dt{font:600 12px Archivo,sans-serif;font-stretch:72%;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:hsl(220 8% 36%)}.ds-mill dd{font:13.5px 'Geist Mono',monospace;text-align:end;color:hsl(222 18% 11%)}

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Header search: white field with ink hairline.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><input placeholder="Search 350gsm art board, PU leather…"><kbd>⌘K</kbd></label>
components.css: .ds-search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;width:420px;height:48px;padding:0 6px 0 16px;background:#fff;border:1px solid rgb(23 26 33/.15);border-radius:6px}.ds-search:focus-within{border-color:hsl(222 18% 11%)}.ds-search input{flex:1;border:0;outline:0;font:400 15px Geist,sans-serif;caret-color:hsl(16 90% 50%)}.ds-search kbd{font:11px 'Geist Mono',monospace;border:1px solid rgb(23 26 33/.15);border-radius:2px;padding:4px 8px;background:hsl(60 4% 92%)}

narrative.overview: The page is the board a swatch book lies on; every product is a swatch card; every category is a stock colour; every spec is printed like a mill label. Persuade surfaces (home, category landings) let the world carry the page; Operate surfaces (listings, product, cart, checkout, account) take only type, palette, density and the swatch card.
keyCharacteristics: Board-grey ground, white cards, binder ink
Seven category stocks used as whole fields
Specs in mono, keys in condensed caps
One cutter orange for the next action

rules.name: The Field Rule
rules.body: A stock colour fills a shape or it is not used.

rules.name: The One Orange Rule
rules.body: At most one cutter-orange filled button per viewport.

rules.name: Numbers line up
rules.body: Prices, quantities and specs use tabular-nums.

dos: Show specs and supplier on every product card
Theme selection, caret, focus and scrollbars
donts: No beauty-era patterns, serif display or cream grounds
No decorative gradients, glass or glows
